description: Phase A: Backend Partner Model in moovv-fit-backend-node. Create Partner and PartnerMembership entities in the platform schema, add Partner API endpoints, and migrate Kinetic Age data. The existing platform schema (from migration 20260926000001) already has partner_developers and partner_invite_codes tables - the Partner table extends this with B2B partner metadata.
steps: 1. Create migration /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/database/migrations/20261006000001-create-partner-tables.cjs that: (a) Creates platform.partner table with columns: id (UUID, PK), name (VARCHAR 255, NOT NULL), logo_s3_key (VARCHAR 255, nullable), api_mode (VARCHAR 20, default 'PORTAL', CHECK IN ('SDK','PORTAL','BOTH')), sandbox_api_key (VARCHAR 64, nullable, unique), live_api_key (VARCHAR 64, nullable, unique), status (VARCHAR 20, default 'ACTIVE', CHECK IN ('ACTIVE','INACTIVE')), created_at, updated_at. (b) Creates platform.partner_membership table with columns: id (UUID, PK), partner_id (UUID, FK to platform.partner), user_email (VARCHAR 255, NOT NULL - references Docs Pool user), role (VARCHAR 20, default 'DEVELOPER', CHECK IN ('ADMIN','DEVELOPER')), created_at. (c) Adds partner_id column to existing platform.partner_developers table with FK to platform.partner. (d) Adds unique index on (partner_id, user_email) for partner_membership.

2. Create Sequelize model /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/database/models/infrastructure/Partner.ts following the Organization.ts pattern but using UUID primary key. Fields: id, name, logoS3Key, apiMode ('SDK'|'PORTAL'|'BOTH'), sandboxApiKey, liveApiKey, status ('ACTIVE'|'INACTIVE'), createdAt, updatedAt. Add @HasMany for PartnerMembership association.

3. Create Sequelize model /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/database/models/infrastructure/PartnerMembership.ts. Fields: id (UUID), partnerId (FK), userEmail, role ('ADMIN'|'DEVELOPER'), createdAt. Add @BelongsTo for Partner association.
4. Update /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/database/models/infrastructure/index.ts to export Partner and PartnerMembership models.
5. Add PartnerApiMode, PartnerStatus, and PartnerMemberRole enums to /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/shared/constants/enums.ts.

6. Create handler /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/handlers/admin-list-partners.ts: GET /api/admin/partners. Uses verifyAdminToken(), queries platform.partner with member counts, returns partner list. Follow admin-list-organizations.ts pattern.
7. Create handler /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/handlers/admin-get-partner.ts: GET /api/admin/partners/{partnerId}. Returns single partner with members array.

8. Create handler /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/handlers/admin-create-partner.ts: POST /api/admin/partners. Body: {name, apiMode?, logoS3Key?}. Generates sandbox_api_key and live_api_key (crypto.randomBytes), creates partner record.
9. Create handler /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/handlers/admin-update-partner.ts: PUT /api/admin/partners/{partnerId}. Updates name, logoS3Key, apiMode, status.

10. Create handler /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/handlers/admin-add-partner-member.ts: POST /api/admin/partners/{partnerId}/members. Body: {userEmail, role?}. Creates PartnerMembership record. Validates email format.
11. Create handler /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/handlers/admin-remove-partner-member.ts: DELETE /api/admin/partners/{partnerId}/members/{memberId}. Deletes PartnerMembership record.

12. Add all 6 Partner routes to /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/serverless.yml under functions section, following the admin-organizations pattern. Routes: GET/POST /api/admin/partners, GET/PUT /api/admin/partners/{partnerId}, POST /api/admin/partners/{partnerId}/members, DELETE /api/admin/partners/{partnerId}/members/{memberId}.

13. Create data migration script /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/scripts/migrate-kinetic-age.ts: (a) Find or create Partner record for 'Kinetic Age' with apiMode='SDK', status='ACTIVE'. (b) Find existing Docs Pool user for Kinetic Age in platform.partner_developers. (c) Create PartnerMembership linking the user email to the Partner with role='ADMIN'. (d) Update partner_developers.partner_id to link to the new Partner. Script is idempotent - checks for existing records before creating.
14. Update /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/docs/architecture/db/manifest.md to document new platform.partner and platform.partner_membership tables.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors in moovv-fit-backend-node
Migration 20261006000001 creates platform.partner and platform.partner_membership tables with correct columns and constraints
Partner and PartnerMembership models export correctly from src/database/models/index.ts
All 6 Partner API handlers compile and follow existing admin handler patterns
serverless.yml includes all Partner routes with correct paths and methods
Kinetic Age migration script is ready to run (not auto-executed - manual step for production)
findings: Migration script scripts/migrate-kinetic-age.ts requires DB connection to run. It is idempotent and links all existing partner_developers without a partner_id to the new Kinetic Age Partner. Run manually: npx ts-node scripts/migrate-kinetic-age.ts
